sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. Case No.892 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Jajpur road, arising out of Jajpur Road P.S. Case No.324 of 2023, for commission of alleged offences under Section 498A/323/506/507/34 of IPC read with Section 4 of the DP Act and Section 67/67(a) of the IT Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
District and Sessions Judge, Jajpur road by order dated 01.09.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text:
Addl.
District and Sessions Judge, Jajpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.

5. Taking into account the nature of allegation and since the consideration by the learned Court in seisin was during the course of investigation, this Court is not inclined to consider this bail application without having the benefit of consideration of materials qua the accusation relating to the petitioners by the learned Court in seisin, post charge sheet.
6.
granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer after examination of material witnesses,
7. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
